About CTTC

Nairobi's Top Table Tennis Club

City Table Tennis Club (CTTC) is based at City Stadium, at the beginning of Jogoo Road, Nairobi — the club where talent is nurtured, from a child's first rally to a national champion's podium.

Our certified coaches deliver structured training across four programmes. Affiliated with Table Tennis Kenya (TTK), we compete at local, regional, and national level throughout the year.

Training Programmes

A programme for every player

From your first rally to the national podium — all levels coached under one roof.

🧒

Beginner & Kids

Fun, safe introduction for children and adults. Learn grip, footwork, service, and basic rally techniques in a supportive environment.

Ages 6+ · No equipment needed
→ Every weekday
🏃

Recreational Adult

Social sessions, internal leagues, and round-robins for working adults seeking competitive but relaxed play in a vibrant community.

18+ · All skill levels
→ Evenings & Saturdays
🏆

Competitive & National

High-performance coaching for players targeting county, national, and regional competition. Tactical coaching, multi-ball drilling, tournament prep.

By trial / invitation
→ Daily sessions
☀️

Holiday Camps & Clinics

Intensive school-holiday camps with full-day sessions, mini-tournaments, and certificates. Themed clinics on serve, footwork, and loop technique.

Ages 8–18 · School holidays
→ Book 2 weeks ahead
